Matters for Attention

Q Does it support video output?
A No, it is only used for data transmission. “Not for DisplayPort Alt Mode or HDMI Video Output”
Q Are all USB-C ports Support 10Gbps?
A No, The total available bandwidth (10Gbps) is shared across all connected devices.
Q Can the PD port charge my laptop?
A Yes, the PD port charges "Host" devices only, not peripherals.
Q Will multiple high-power SSDs or hard drives cause disconnections?
A Exceeding total bandwidth (10Gbps) may cause disconnection. Connect one one or two SSD at a time.

How customer reviews and ratings work

Customer Reviews, including Product Star Ratings help customers to learn more about the product and decide whether it is the right product for them.

To calculate the overall star rating and percentage breakdown by star, we don’t use a simple average. Instead, our system considers things like how recent a review is and if the reviewer bought the item on Amazon. It also analyzed reviews to verify trustworthiness.

    This is an update to my original review. The first one had a few issues of which are in the original review at the bottom of this one. I was sent a replacement that works! It does exactly what I needed, data transfer with USB C support, nothing else. No there is no video capability, but there are so many hubs and docking stations out there that do have that capability it became a problem in my configuration. I have more video connections than I could ever use, but was left high and dry on USB C. I also use a wheel device and external keypad in my workflow that wouldn't work with another product I tried. It works with this just fine. It also is the first part of a chain linking two other hubs together with the first product I tried at the end of that chain. The price...it solved a problem with it being the only solution I could find and is one of the less costly parts of my entire setup as well leaving me more room for expansion. I would call that a bargain.

    This was exactly what I needed, did exactly what I needed it to do for one whole day. The second day is when things went whacky. I couldn't access any of the connected drives which at that moment there were three. So, I shut everything down and just tried unplugging everything and then plugging it back in. Start the computer back up and nothing. Once again, I shut everything down and swapped cords around this time starting in the ports I hadn't used. What were in the new ports worked, the one drive that was in one of the others didn't work. What's kind of odd is the third problem port. sometimes will work if I plug something in while with everything on, but it's not seen on a reboot. It's built well and is really the best solution I have found for my setup. I gave it 3 stars when as it is now, doesn't deserve any, but they are sending me a replacement. A fully working version of this, that works longer than one day and hopefully for a long period of time is definitely a 5 star buy. Hoping this was just a fluke. Once I get the replacement and if it performs as it should I will update this review to where it should be. If not, I will downgrade it to also where it should be.

    Reviewed in the United States on June 25, 2026

    Full content visible, double tap to read brief content.

    I bought this USB C Hub for my laptop and was very disappointed. Upon opening and connecting via USB C 3.2. port on my laptop, I noticed the connection felt very mushy and loose. Not secure at all and comes out easily, tested on multiple ports. The device was not recognized right away and I had to play around with the connection to get any sort of connectivity. The Power delivery is also finicky and does not always work. I performed several disk speed tests with the USB C Hub using my portable SSD, and also by directly connecting the portable SSD to the laptop.

    When portable SSD directly connected, I had read and write speeds around 1000 MB/s. When portable SSD connected to the USB C Hub, I had read and write speeds of around 40 MB/s. Also while connected to the USB C Hub, the speed test was extremely unstable, and freezing. The quality is poor, and functionality is mediocre. Save yourself some time and skip this one. It's a huge waste of money and definitely not getting any value from this product.
